controls: same task.md and fixed source summaries
same model inherited; exact model ID/seed/temperature not exposed
generation_protocol: Save first draft; count Han characters; at most one length correction; retain draft and final. No selecting among multiple generated answers.
evaluation: Independent fresh reviewer sees task and V/W/X/Y only, no rules or version mapping. Compare V/W and X/Y.
limits: fixed-source explanation test, not live search or automatic skill triggering
revision to length may itself affect tone; initial drafts retained
compressed core changes phrasing and emphasis, not solely token count
